description: The file is an HTML document that implements a web-based user interface for visualizing database contents, including sidebars for database and table selection, and a main content area for displaying table data.
external_files: fetch API (used for network requests if observed in scripts)

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from API and populates sidebar

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resets state and UI

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of tables for a selected database and loads tables

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays list of tables for a selected database

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays table data for a selected table

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders table data in HTML format

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content with handling for long text, objects, and nulls

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content that exceeds visible length
